title: X gate
description:
The $X$ gate you just saw transforms $$\ket 0$$ into $$\ket 1$$, and $$\ket 1$$ into $$\ket 0$$. It is thus the quantum equivalent of the NOT gate for classical computers.
 
It is represented as $$X = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix} = \ket0\bra1 + \ket1\bra0$$


In this circuit, the state after the hidden elements is $\ket{01}$ as seen in the results panel. Drag and drop the correct gates to transform the circuit to $\ket{10}$
explanation: Note that the $X$ gate are *involutory*, which means that applying them twice effectively does nothing! You'll notice this later in many of our other gates as well.
